world_source: existing BENCH native city/world and PX4 Gazebo providers; preserve original inspection suite

clock.source: closed SceneState / StageBarrier / PX4 provider events

facilities.status: exact geometry/frame/model calibration must be bound before compilation
facilities.geometry: existing FacilityLandingPad rectangle; no guessed coordinate transformation
facilities.dropoff_source_candidate: explicit authored pad on existing BENCH ground; validate actual geometry before launch

declared_demo_policy.note: Authored demo policy, not measured hardware capability. Pad footprint and pose-reference calibration are mandatory independent inputs; no half-height default.

custody.claim: modeled admitted business custody tied to real closed native pose, not a simulated gripper/parcel aerodynamics measurement

attachment.frame: explicit body-local transform, required in compiled configuration
attachment.missing_semantics: cannot compile carriage without declared transform
attachment.projection: backend shared entity snapshot; renderer only displays supplied parcel pose

transitions.pickup: exact order/parcel/carrier/facility and closed native contiguous dwell + received authorized action; one-shot transfer record; network report alone insufficient
transitions.in_transit: admitted pickup plus later real in-air closed native state; no future binding
transitions.delivery: exact destination geometry/body clearance/landed speed/contact + contiguous dwell AND admitted dropoff/handoff; transfer and detach exactly once
transitions.duplicate: same accepted action id returns original decision and transfer; different payload conflicts explicitly
transitions.missing: UNKNOWN/unconfirmed; do not infer presence, custody or delivery from labels or missing observations

runtime_seal_distinction: live admitted business state is not independently verified; the separate sealed verifier replays full source windows, commands and custody records. Never mint VerifiedDwellProvenance during live execution.

verifier.logistics_component: new explicit logistics-native sealed verifier/config required; cannot relabel the inspection image
verifier.pin_gap: Existing pinned image resolves inspection packages/goals only; native parcel dispatch and separately sealed custody/delivery verifier are not implemented. No digest substitution or run is authorized by this handoff alone.

scope: one bounded new native logistics run only after contract/source review and compilation closure; current task is code preparation
unsupported: charge transition in this minimal scenario
physical gripper dynamics or parcel mass effects unless separately declared/supported
old inspection report deliveries as logistics orders
